digest.component_or_area: mutation confirmation system (CLI testing & documentation hardening)
propositions: Reduce-path structural test must spy the shared confirmation seam (_confirm.emit/_confirm.emit_text) to catch regressions where per-verb formatters bypass the seam and print directly, validated by parametrized tests over create/link/transition with call-count assertions.

Verb no-op inventory (no-op-capable vs always-writes classification) must be curated durably in scripts/gen_cli_reference.py and rendered into generated docs/cli-reference.md, with a CI drift gate that fails when _CONFIRM_SCOPE and the curated MUTATION_VERBS key set diverge.

Confirmation-line old→new mapping table (pre-42cd70b889 → today) must be recorded in generated docs/cli-reference.md sourced from curated data in the generator, capturing the previous behavior (e.g. transition's UNBLOCKED output on CLOSE only, silence on other targets).
No follow-up store reads by confirmation formatters must be verified by formatting with empty tmp dir and REBAR_ROOT unset, ensuring no stored state is required to produce output.
